   162	def _replay(n, capacity, e_u, e_v, e_ping, e_ack, rounds, out_edges, outdeg,

   164	    """Run the discrete-event replay; return metrics and round instrumentation."""
   165	    nr = len(rounds)
   166	    entries = [dict() for _ in range(nr)]
   167	    node_use = [0] * n
   168	    node_peak = [0] * n
   169	    total_use = 0
   170	    total_peak = 0
   171	
   172	    m_net_ping_tx = 0
   173	    m_net_ack_tx = 0
   174	    m_host_ack_tx = 0
   175	    m_dedup = 0
   176	    m_cap_drops = 0
   177	    m_late_ping = 0
   178	    m_ignored_ack = 0
   179	    m_allocations = 0
   180	
   181	    started = [False] * nr
   182	    final_us = [None] * nr
   183	    final_complete = [None] * nr
   184	    source_proof = [None] * nr
   185	    host_delivery = [None] * nr
   186	
   187	    heap = []
   188	    heappush = heapq.heappush
   189	    heappop = heapq.heappop
   190	    seq = [0]
   191	
   192	    def add(time, prio, rnd, key, data):
   193	        seq[0] += 1
   194	        heappush(heap, (time, prio, rnd, key, seq[0], data))
   195	
   196	    def finalize(time, rnd, node, entry, complete):
   197	        nonlocal m_host_ack_tx, m_net_ack_tx
   198	        entry.finalized = True
   199	        entry.complete = complete
   200	        frozen = tuple(sorted(entry.proof))
   201	        payload = (frozen, complete)
   202	        if node == 0:
   203	            final_us[rnd] = time
   204	            final_complete[rnd] = complete
   205	            source_proof[rnd] = entry.proof
   206	            m_host_ack_tx += 1
   207	            if not rounds[rnd][3]:
   208	                add(time + rounds[rnd][2], PRIO_HOSTACK, rnd, -1, None)
   209	        parents = entry.parents
   210	        if parents:
   211	            drop_ack = rounds[rnd][5]
   212	            for parent in parents:
   213	                m_net_ack_tx += 1
   214	                if parent not in drop_ack:
   215	                    add(time + e_ack[parent], PRIO_ACK, rnd, parent, payload)
   216	        entry.parents = ()
   217	
   218	    for rnd in range(nr):
   219	        add(rounds[rnd][0], PRIO_PING, rnd, -1, None)
   220	        add(deadlines[rnd] + 1, PRIO_RELEASE, rnd, -1, None)
   221	
   222	    last_us = 0
   223	    while heap:
   224	        time, prio, rnd, key, _seq, data = heappop(heap)
   225	        last_us = time
   226	        if prio == PRIO_PING:
   227	            if key < 0:
   228	                node = 0
   229	                parent = None
   230	            else:
   231	                node = e_v[key]
   232	                parent = key
   233	            if time > deadlines[rnd]:
   234	                m_late_ping += 1
   235	                continue
   236	            entry = entries[rnd].get(node)
   237	            if entry is not None:
   238	                m_dedup += 1
   239	                if parent is not None:
   240	                    if entry.finalized:
   241	                        m_net_ack_tx += 1
   242	                        if parent not in rounds[rnd][5]:
   243	                            cached = tuple(sorted(entry.proof))
   244	                            payload = (cached, entry.complete)
   245	                            add(time + e_ack[parent], PRIO_ACK, rnd, parent,
   246	                                payload)
   247	                    else:
   248	                        entry.parents.add(parent)
   249	                continue
   250	            if node_use[node] >= capacity[node]:
   251	                m_cap_drops += 1
   252	                continue
   253	            entry = _Entry(parent)
   254	            entries[rnd][node] = entry
   255	            node_use[node] += 1
   256	            total_use += 1
   257	            if node_use[node] > node_peak[node]:
   258	                node_peak[node] = node_use[node]
   259	            if total_use > total_peak:
   260	                total_peak = total_use
   261	            m_allocations += 1
   262	            if node == 0:
   263	                started[rnd] = True
   264	            add(deadlines[rnd], PRIO_TIMEOUT, rnd, node, None)
   265	            outs = out_edges[node]
   266	            if outs:
   267	                drop_ping = rounds[rnd][4]
   268	                for oe in outs:
   269	                    m_net_ping_tx += 1
   270	                    if oe not in drop_ping:
   271	                        add(time + e_ping[oe], PRIO_PING, rnd, oe, None)
   272	            else:

   276	            entry = entries[rnd].get(node)
   277	            if entry is None or entry.finalized or key in entry.credited:
   278	                m_ignored_ack += 1
   279	                continue
   280	            entry.credited[key] = data[1]
   281	            carried = data[0]
   282	            if carried:
   283	                entry.proof.update(carried)
   284	            entry.proof.add(key)

   298	        else:
   299	            round_entries = entries[rnd]
   300	            if round_entries:
   301	                for node in round_entries:
   302	                    node_use[node] -= 1
   303	                    total_use -= 1
   304	                entries[rnd] = {}
   305	
   306	    metrics = {
   307	        "host_probe_tx": nr,
   308	        "network_ping_tx": m_net_ping_tx,
   309	        "network_ack_tx": m_net_ack_tx,
   310	        "host_ack_tx": m_host_ack_tx,
   311	        "deduplicated_ping": m_dedup,
   312	        "capacity_drops": m_cap_drops,
   313	        "late_ping": m_late_ping,
   314	        "ignored_ack": m_ignored_ack,
   315	        "allocations": m_allocations,
   316	        "cache_peak": node_peak,
   317	        "peak_entries": total_peak,
   318	        "end_us": last_us if nr else 0,
   319	    }

   321	        "started": started,
   322	        "final_us": final_us,
   323	        "final_complete": final_complete,
   324	        "source_proof": source_proof,
   325	        "host_delivery": host_delivery,
   326	    }
   327	    return metrics, state
